scripts.script:
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()
local Window = Library.CreateLib("Borderland Season 3", "Ocean")

local allGames = {
    "Solitary Confinement",
    "Hide and Seek",
    "Labyrinth",
    "Tag",
    "Checkmate",
    "Boiling Death",
    "Human Elevator",
    "Osmosis",
    "Dead or Alive",
    "Target",
    "Beauty Contest",
    "King of Spades",
}

local exploitCategories = {
    ["Solitary Confinement"] = {"ESP / Wallhack", "Fly", "Noclip", "CFrame", "WalkSpeed / JumpPower Mod"},
    ["Hide and Seek"] = {"ESP / Position‑Reveal", "Noclip", "Teleport", "CFrame Speed / WalkSpeed Mod", "Auto‑search / Botting"},
    ["Labyrinth"] = {"Teleport", "Noclip", "CFrame / Fast‑Move", "WalkSpeed Mod", "Auto‑path / Auto‑solve"},
    ["Tag"] = {"WalkSpeed / CFrame Speed", "Teleport", "Noclip", "Invulnerability toggles", "Auto‑input / Macros"},
    ["Checkmate"] = {"Move‑automation / Scripted‑Moves", "Teleport (board positioning)", "CFrame manipulation", "Auto‑aim / Auto‑target", "Replay‑injection"},
    ["Boiling Death"] = {"Noclip / Phase through hazards", "Teleport (to safe zones)", "WalkSpeed / CFrame Speed", "Auto‑avoid bots"},
    ["Human Elevator"] = {"CFrame / Timing manipulation", "Teleport", "Fly", "WalkSpeed Mod"},
    ["Osmosis"] = {"Client‑state toggles", "CFrame / Speed", "Fly / Noclip", "Auto‑play"},
    ["Dead or Alive"] = {"Teleport (to influence zones)", "WalkSpeed / CFrame Speed", "Botting / Automated decision scripts", "ESP (if hidden info exists)"},
    ["Target"] = {"AimAssist / Auto‑aim / SilentAim", "ESP (target highlighting)", "CFrame / Recoil / Spread manipulation", "Input Automation (Macros)"},
    ["Beauty Contest"] = {"UI/Score Forgery", "Automated submissions / Botting", "Client‑side attribute tweaks"},
    ["King of Spades"] = {"Teleport / CFrame positioning", "Damage / Invulnerability modifiers", "Noclip / Fly", "Scripted attack automation"},
}

for _, gameName in pairs(allGames) do
    local Tab = Window:NewTab(gameName)
    local Section = Tab:NewSection("Activate:")

    local cats = exploitCategories[gameName] or {}
    local toggleStatus = {}
    local buttons = {}

    local masterToggle = Section:NewButton("Activate All", "", function(master)
        local anyOff = false
        for _, cat in ipairs(cats) do
            if not toggleStatus[cat] then
                anyOff = true
                break
            end
        end

        for i, cat in ipairs(cats) do
            toggleStatus[cat] = anyOff
            if anyOff then
                buttons[i]:UpdateText(cat .. " ✅")
                buttons[i]:UpdateColor(Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 180))
            else
                buttons[i]:UpdateText(cat)
                buttons[i]:UpdateColor(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
            end
        end

        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "Borderland",
            Text = (anyOff and "Activated Cheats for " or "Deactivated Cheats for ") .. gameName,
            Duration = 2
        })

        master:UpdateColor(Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 255))
        task.delay(0.2, function()
            master:UpdateColor(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
        end)
    end)

    for _, cat in ipairs(cats) do
        toggleStatus[cat] = false
        local btn = Section:NewButton(cat, "", function(button)
            toggleStatus[cat] = not toggleStatus[cat]
            if toggleStatus[cat] then
                button:UpdateText(cat .. " ✅")
                button:UpdateColor(Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 180))
            else
                button:UpdateText(cat)
                button:UpdateColor(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
            end
        end)
        table.insert(buttons, btn)
    end
end
